title: Hybrid SCIM/SAML provisioning + periodic access review automation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a hybrid identity provisioning and periodic certification flow to satisfy audit requirements for access evidence across hosted and private deployments. Workstreams: 1) SCIM reconciliation + on-demand delta provisioning; 2) SAML attribute mapping and group -> role sync; 3) Orphan account detection + automated remediation proposals; 4) Evidence export pipeline (signed CSV/Parquet) and scheduler for periodic access reviews.
background: Auditors require: periodic proof that only approved principals have privileged roles, a repeatable certification process, and machine-readable exports of who had access when. Current gaps: SCIM delta failures go unnoticed, SAML group-to-role mappings are ambiguous, and evidence exports are manual (ad-hoc queries + spreadsheets).
acceptance_criteria: SCIM connector performs incremental sync within SLA (max 5m delta for 50k identities) and emits reconciliation events to the audit log
SAML group attributes are mappable to platform role templates; UI shows mapping with preview of affected users
Access review job runs on schedule (configurable cadence), generates signed evidence export, and surfaces pending certifications to reviewers
Orphan account detector flags accounts without IAM source for >30 days and opens suggested remediation ticket (revoke or escalate), with no false positives in 1-week smoke test
Exports stored in customer-residency-aware buckets with retention metadata and immutable manifests for auditors
tasks: Design SCIM recon pipeline and idempotent delta processor
Add SAML attribute mapping UI + backend mapping service
Implement orphan account detector and remediation workflow
Build evidence export service (CSV/Parquet) with signature and residency labeling
Create access review scheduler and reviewer UI flows
Instrument metrics/tracing and add dashboards for sync health and review completion
progress_updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with Security and Product. Agreed scope and SLA targets. Assigned Marco as tech lead.
2025-02-18: Spike completed. SCIM delta via change tokens looks feasible; edge cases for large group churn documented (see confluence link).
2025-02-25: Prototype SAML mapping UI wireframe reviewed by Design (Ava Kim). Feedback: expose preview and bulk edit. UX iteration planned for 2025-W09.
2025-03-01: Implemented initial SCIM delta consumer and test harness. Found rate-limit backoff needed when reconciling large orgs — switched to tokenized windowing approach.
2025-03-04: Evidence export schema finalized (Parquet + signature bundle). Security reviewed export format; approved with key rotation notes.
design_considerations: Event-driven SCIM recon reduces cost vs full periodic scans but requires robust idempotency and retry logic
Tradeoff: immediate revocation vs staged removal for user disruption. Default to 'propose -> manager approve' for privileged roles, configurable per tenant
Evidence should be both human-readable (CSV) and machine-validated (Parquet + signed manifest). Avoid proprietary blobs for auditors
Residency constraints: exports must be written to region-specific buckets and comply with customer residency tags. Keep metadata alongside export to prove retention policy enforcement
risks_and_mitigations: SCIM provider rate-limits causing stale state: mitigation - incremental tokenized sync + exponential backoff + backfill job
False orphan detections for service accounts: mitigation - maintain allowlist of service principals and require verification before auto-revoke
Reviewer fatigue causing certification slippage: mitigation - default reviewer lists, batching, and SLA alerts + manager reminders
Data residency violations if export lands in wrong region: mitigation - region enforcement at time-of-export and preflight validation
review_feedback: Security (Jordan Li): need KMS envelope signatures for export bundles; track key rotation dates in manifest
Product (Maya Thompson): prefer manager-driven remediation for customer control; add opt-in auto-revoke for low-risk roles
Design (Ava Kim): ensure reviewer UI surfaces changes since last certification (diff) and provides bulk actions
test_plan: Unit tests for SCIM delta consumer and idempotent apply
Integration test with Okta sandbox tenant simulating 10k users and group churn
End-to-end test of access review flow with synthetic reviewers and simulated approvals/declines
Smoke test for export signing and regional write permission enforcement
rollout_plan: Canary: enable feature for internal demo orgs and 2 pilot customers (week 1)
Beta: open to self-serve tenants with opt-in (week 2-4)
GA: full rollout with default manager approval flowed into tenant policy (after 4 weeks of stability)
Post-GA: add automated audit reports for SOC2 customers and tenant-level retention overrides
qa_checks: No SCIM sync errors > 5% over a 24h window in pilot orgs
All generated evidence files have valid signature manifests and region tags
Access reviews for pilot orgs complete within configured SLA 85% of the time
No accidental revocations of allowlisted service accounts during smoke run
outcomes_expected: Reduced manual audit prep time by >70% for pilot customers
Fewer orphaned privileged accounts (target: 90% auto-detected within 7 days)
Operational visibility: dashboard showing recon lag, review completion rate, and export success rate
Clear evidence exports that satisfy external auditors and speed up compliance signoff
